verdict.rationale: Payout timing and accelerated (next-day or instant) payouts are a fair question for a payment processor like SumUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers checkouts, refunds, terminals, webhooks, the MCP server and pricing, but nothing documents payout schedules, payout visibility, or next-day or instant payout options.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
